research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Etched.ai appears to be researching tensor parallel group architectures and performance of tensor operations across multiple processing devices, as well as tensor operations in AI models. They develop model specific ASIC compilation by modifying template models and using fused kernel replacement. Their work includes parallel execution of self attention based AI models using an AI hardware platform and multi chip systolic arrays. Together, these efforts target AI hardware, compiler flows, and efficient transformer style computation.

overview_description.description: Etched develops artificial intelligence hardware and software systems for inference workloads. The company designs specialized AI chips alongside supporting components, including racks, interconnects, software, and manufacturing processes, to optimize the deployment of large-scale AI models. Its technology focuses on improving throughput, latency, power efficiency, and memory performance for transformer-based and mixture-of-experts inference workloads. Etched also develops rack-scale inference systems that integrate compute, memory, networking, and cooling technologies into a unified platform. The company works on the validation, production, and deployment of its inference infrastructure for customers running large language models and other advanced AI applications.
